repository_validation.environment: Windows Python 3.12; local test sockets enabled, fresh composed pinned JavaScript/mobile site

board_effects: Authorized RAM loading and final boot-flash installation reset the P2 and replace disposable project code; USB --reboot verifies a real flash boot and stored CRCs. Final dd31daa9 image passed all nine flash-boot suites. Final VM soft reset stops jobs/releases outputs. No Windows browser interaction used.
implementation_boundaries: HUBSET filter writes use class 4 only; main cog serializes programming. Reporters are tracked shadow settings, not register readback.
Retiming refuses any tracked user-pin consumer of the selected bank, including raw configurations; identical setting succeeds. Stop-all retains bank settings; hardware boot restores defaults.
External continuous producer is heap-free with 1023 usable entries, preserves all 32 bits and stops before an overflow acknowledgement. It does not pause for GC.
Host test drains at 20 kbit/s and verifies 45312 pattern bits with five GCs and concurrent cog progress; 1 MHz test retains 32736 bits at overflow, not sustained host throughput.
Exact worker accounting uses a graceful batch-completion handshake. Forced cancellation can discard a result already removed from the ring.
Fragmentation test uses a legal 1012-byte code payload / 1019-byte wire packet with matching CRC; no parser or generic VM changes in this revision.
remaining_limits: USB operating mode 27 needs separate even DM/odd DP wiring, safe VBUS and a protocol stack; not attempted on hard-short pairs.
External ADC/UART/SPI hardware, actual SMPS power circuitry, independent clock/voltage references and analog performance remain unvalidated.
Internal full-clock raw capture remains finite; continuous internal capture, streamer DMA and programmable pretrigger history remain unimplemented.
One shared capture session, 1023 usable entries; source rate and consumer/transport throughput must be matched. External producer contract <=1 MHz; 115200 UART cannot carry native internal bit rates.
